title: Dispensary Near Michiana & Long Beach, IN
metaDescription: From Michiana or Long Beach, IN? Our New Buffalo dispensary is nearby. Directions, FAQs, fast in-store shopping. 21+ only.
h1: Cannabis Near Michiana & Long Beach, IN (Just Over the State Line on US-12)

hero.lead: Quick drive into New Buffalo with easy access off US-12, ideal for Lake Michigan weekends and Michigan day trips.

items.title: Getting Here from Michiana, IN (via US-12 E → New Buffalo)
items.md:
1. Head east on US-12 toward New Buffalo / Michigan.
2. Cross the state line and stay on US-12 through the New Buffalo commercial corridor.
3. Continue to 19189 US-12, New Buffalo, MI 49117 (High Society is right on US-12).

[Get Directions](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8oANXpmVzFSHBqru8)

items.title: Getting Here from Long Beach, IN (via US-12 E / Dunes Hwy → New Buffalo)
items.md:
1. Take US-12 (Dunes Hwy) east toward Michigan City, then continue toward New Buffalo / Michigan.
2. After crossing into Michigan, remain on US-12 to 19189 US-12, New Buffalo, MI 49117.

[Get Directions](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8oANXpmVzFSHBqru8)

items.title: Parking
items.md: **Parking Notes:** On-site parking makes this a simple stop-and-go. Peak summer Fridays/Saturdays can get busier on US-12, so arriving earlier in the day is usually fastest.

blocks.heading: Fast Pickup, Friendly Team
blocks.md: Walk in, get checked in, and head to the counter. Most visits take under 10 minutes. Our team can point you to popular categories and answer questions. We accept cash and debit; ATMs are available on site. The store and parking are accessible.

blocks.heading: For Indiana Lake Trips
items: A “just over the border” stop when you’re headed toward New Buffalo / Harbor Country
Easy to pair with beach days and weekend rentals
Fast pickup-friendly: order ahead, grab, and get back on the road

blocks.heading: Crossing state lines
blocks.md: Heading home? Enjoy responsibly in Michigan and don’t travel across state lines with cannabis. Read our [Indiana law guide](/cannabis-laws-by-state/indiana/) before you go.
